content.text: Night wakings at 8 can flare up with back-to-school anxiety, friend stress, or just a schedule that's shifted over summer. Try anchoring her bedtime routine tighter - same wind-down steps, lights out within a 15-minute window every night - and check whether she's getting enough physical activity to burn off the day.

input.offer: Want the full sleep plan for her age? Reply YES and I'll send it night by night.
